```{=html}
<section class="legal-page">

<style>
@import url('[https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Comfortaa:wght@700&display=swap](https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Comfortaa:wght@700&display=swap)');

/* =====================================
   FOND GÉNÉRAL
===================================== */

html, body, #quarto-content {
  background-color: #F4F0E8 !important;
}

#title-block-header {
  display: none !important;
}

.legal-page {
  max-width: 1200px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 35px 22px;
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
  background: transparent;
  font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
  color: #293747;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.legal-page * {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

/* =====================================
   FILIGRANES
===================================== */

.lavande-filigrane {
  position: fixed;
  right: 15px;
  bottom: 10px;
  width: 190px;
  height: auto;
  opacity: 0.17;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
}

.ble-filigrane {
  position: fixed;
  left: 8px;
  bottom: 15px;
  width: 175px;
  height: auto;
  opacity: 0.19;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
}

/* =====================================
   TITRE PRINCIPAL
===================================== */

.legal-header {
  position: relative;
  margin-bottom: 30px;
  padding: 26px 12px 18px;
  text-align: center;
  overflow: visible;
}

.balance-filigrane {
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  top: 32%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  width: 210px;
  height: auto;
  opacity: 0.14;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
}

.legal-eyebrow {
  color: #9b784b;
  font-size: 14px;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  font-weight: bold;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.legal-page h2 {
  font-family: 'Comfortaa', sans-serif;
  font-size: clamp(32px, 5vw, 46px);
  line-height: 1.2;
  color: #26394d;
  margin: 0 0 14px;
  border: none;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

.legal-subtitle {
  color: #59636e;
  font-size: 18px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  margin: 0;
}

/* =====================================
   BANNIÈRE BLEUE
===================================== */

.legal-banner {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 22px;
  background: #26394d;
  color: white;
  padding: 28px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 22px;
  box-shadow: 0 5px 16px rgba(38,57,77,0.10);
}

.banner-icon {
  font-size: 38px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.legal-banner span,
.legal-alert span {
  display: block;
  font-size: 12px;
  letter-spacing: 1.8px;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #d2b17d;
}

.legal-banner h3 {
  margin: 9px 0;
  font-size: 23px;
  color: #fff;
}

.legal-banner p {
  margin: 0;
  color: #e3e7eb;
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

/* =====================================
   CARTES JURIDIQUES
===================================== */

.legal-cards {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  gap: 18px;
  margin-bottom: 22px;
}

.legal-card {
  padding: 26px;
  border: 1px solid #e5e0d8;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(38,57,77,0.05);
}

.article {
  color: #9b784b;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: bold;
  letter-spacing: 1.5px;
}

.symbol {
  font-size: 29px;
  margin: 17px 0 10px;
}

.legal-card h3 {
  font-size: 21px;
  color: #26394d;
  margin: 5px 0 12px;
}

.legal-card p {
  font-size: 17px;
  line-height: 1.65;
  color: #59636e;
  margin: 0;
}

/* =====================================
   ENCART BEIGE
===================================== */

.legal-alert {
  padding: 27px;
  border-left: 5px solid #a8895d;
  background: #f7f5f1;
  border-radius: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 22px;
}

.legal-alert span {
  color: #9b784b;
}

.legal-alert > span:first-child {
  font-size: 29px;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.legal-alert h3 {
  font-size: 22px;
  color: #26394d;
  margin: 13px 0;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

.legal-alert p {
  font-size: 17px;
  line-height: 1.7;
  color: #4d5965;
  margin: 0;
}

/* =====================================
   BOUTONS DE RÉFÉRENCE
===================================== */

.legal-button {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 12px 17px;
  margin-top: 18px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  text-decoration: none;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: bold;
  line-height: 1.4;
  transition: background .2s, border-color .2s, transform .2s;
}

.legal-button:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

/* Boutons dans l'encadré beige */

.legal-alert .legal-button {
  color: #26394d;
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid #d8cbb7;
}

.legal-alert .legal-button:hover {
  background: #eee9df;
  border-color: #a8895d;
}

/* Boutons dans la carte blanche */

.legal-card .legal-button {
  color: #26394d;
  background: #f4f0e8;
  border: 1px solid #ded7cb;
}

.legal-card .legal-button:hover {
  background: #e9e3d8;
  border-color: #b49363;
}

/* Boutons dans la bannière bleue */

.legal-banner .legal-button {
  color: #fff;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.10);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.35);
}

.legal-banner .legal-button:hover {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.20);
  border-color: #d2b17d;
}

.button-arrow {
  font-size: 17px;
  color: #b49363;
}

.legal-banner .button-arrow {
  color: #d2b17d;
}

/* =====================================
   RESPONSIVE
===================================== */

@media(max-width:600px) {

  .legal-page {
    padding: 25px 16px;
  }

  .balance-filigrane {
    width: 165px;
    opacity: 0.12;
  }

  .legal-banner {
    align-items: flex-start;
    padding: 21px;
    gap: 15px;
  }

  .legal-banner h3 {
    font-size: 20px;
  }

  .legal-alert {
    padding: 21px;
  }

  .legal-alert h3 {
    font-size: 19px;
  }

  .legal-button {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 12px;
    font-size: 13px;
  }

  .legal-card {
    padding: 21px;
  }

  .lavande-filigrane {
    width: 110px;
    right: -12px;
    bottom: 5px;
    opacity: 0.12;
  }

  .ble-filigrane {
    width: 105px;
    left: -15px;
    bottom: 5px;
    opacity: 0.13;
  }
}

/* =====================================
   IMPRESSION
===================================== */

@media print {

  .ble-filigrane,
  .lavande-filigrane,
  .balance-filigrane {
    display: none !important;
  }

}
</style>

  </p>
```
